steps: Create pyproject.toml with project metadata and dependencies (Django>=5.2,<5.3 LTS)
Define dependency-groups.dev with pytest, pytest-django, ruff, pre-commit, conventional-pre-commit
Run `uv sync --dev` and verify .venv is created
Verify `uv run python --version` returns Python 3.12.x
Verify `uv run python -c "import django; print(django.get_version())"` returns 5.2.x
Run `uv run django-admin startproject config .`
Verify manage.py, config/settings.py, config/urls.py, config/wsgi.py, config/asgi.py exist
Run `uv run python manage.py startapp core`
Add 'core' to INSTALLED_APPS in config/settings.py
Run `uv run python manage.py check` and verify it passes

description: Configure pytest for Django testing in pyproject.toml
steps: Add [tool.pytest.ini_options] to pyproject.toml with DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings
Configure python_files pattern (tests.py, test_*.py, *_tests.py)
Create a basic smoke test in core/tests.py
Run `uv run pytest` and verify it passes

description: Configure ruff linter and formatter in pyproject.toml
steps: Add [tool.ruff] configuration to pyproject.toml (target-version=py312, line-length=100, select=["E", "F", "W", "I", "N", "UP", "C90", "D", "S", "ASYNC", "PERF", "T20", "RET", "PT"])
Run `uv run ruff check .` and verify it passes
Run `uv run ruff format --check .` and verify it passes

description: Add Docker environment with docker-compose (web + PostgreSQL)
steps: Create Dockerfile using python:3.12-slim and uv
Create docker-compose.yml with services `web` (Django app) and `db` (PostgreSQL) with named volume `postgres_data`
Configure volume mounts for hot-reload (source code) and db data persistence
Configure environment variables (DATABASE_URL, DEBUG, SECRET_KEY) via .env.example
Update config/settings.py to read database config from environment
Run `docker compose build` and verify image builds successfully
Run `docker compose up -d` and verify both services are healthy
Run `docker compose exec web python manage.py check` successfully
Run `docker compose down` and verify clean shutdown

description: Create Makefile with common development commands
steps: Create Makefile with targets: install, test, lint, format, up, down, build, logs, shell, migrate, makemigrations, unmigrate, createsuperuser, createsuperuser-auto, pre-commit-install, help
Verify `make help` lists all targets with descriptions
Verify `make test` runs pytest successfully
Verify `make lint` runs ruff check successfully
Verify `make up` starts docker compose services
Verify `make down` stops docker compose services
Verify `make shell` opens a bash shell in the web container
Verify `make makemigrations` and `make migrate` work against the db container
Verify `make unmigrate app=<name> migration=<name>` rolls back a migration
Verify `make createsuperuser-auto username=<name> email=<email> password=<pass>` creates a superuser non-interactively

description: Configure pre-commit with conventional commits, ruff and pytest
steps: Add pre-commit and conventional-pre-commit to dependency-groups.dev
Create .pre-commit-config.yaml with hooks: conventional-pre-commit (commit-msg stage), ruff (check + format), local hook for pytest with pass_filenames=false and always_run=true
Run `uv run pre-commit install --hook-type commit-msg --hook-type pre-commit`
Verify a non-conventional commit message is rejected
Verify a conventional commit message (e.g. 'feat: add X') is accepted
Verify ruff hook runs on staged files
Verify pytest hook runs the full suite before commit completes

description: Generate AGENTS.md documenting main project commands
steps: Create/update AGENTS.md with sections: Setup, Testing, Linting, Docker, Database Migrations, Pre-commit
Document: `make test` and `uv run pytest`
Document: `make lint`, `make format`, `uv run ruff check .`
Document: `make up` / `docker compose up -d` to start the app
Document: `make down` / `docker compose down` to stop the app
Document: `make shell` / `docker compose exec web bash` to access the container
Document: `make makemigrations`, `make migrate`, `make unmigrate app=<> migration=<>` for migrations
Document: `make createsuperuser` (interactive) and `make createsuperuser-auto username=<> email=<> password=<>` (non-interactive) for creating superusers
Document: `make pre-commit-install` and how conventional commits work
Verify AGENTS.md renders correctly and all commands are copy-pasteable

description: Verify complete project setup works end-to-end
steps: Run `make install` from a clean checkout
Run `make lint` and verify it passes
Run `make test` and verify all tests pass
Run `make up` and verify web service responds on configured port
Run `make shell` and verify bash is accessible
Run `make migrate` and verify migrations apply against PostgreSQL
Run `make down` and verify clean shutdown
Attempt a commit with invalid message and verify pre-commit rejects it
Attempt a commit with conventional message and verify pre-commit accepts it

description: Configure commitizen for semantic versioning and release management
steps: Add `commitizen` to dependency-groups.dev in pyproject.toml
Add [tool.commitizen] section to pyproject.toml with version, tag_format='v$version', version_files pointing to pyproject.toml
Verify `uv run cz version` outputs the current project version
Verify `uv run cz check --message 'feat: test'` passes validation
Verify `uv run cz check --message 'invalid message'` fails validation

description: Add Makefile targets for release workflow (release-rc, release, changelog)
steps: Add `release-rc` target to Makefile: `docker compose exec web uv run cz bump --prerelease rc`
Add `release` target to Makefile: `docker compose exec web uv run cz bump`
Add `changelog` target to Makefile: `docker compose exec web uv run cz changelog`
Update `make help` to document release-rc, release, and changelog targets
Update .PHONY to include release-rc, release, changelog

description: Configure pytest-cov with 80% minimum coverage threshold
steps: Add `pytest-cov` to dependency-groups.dev in pyproject.toml
Add coverage configuration to [tool.pytest.ini_options]: addopts = '--cov=. --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=80'
Add [tool.coverage.run] section to pyproject.toml with omit patterns (migrations, manage.py, config/wsgi.py, config/asgi.py)
Add [tool.coverage.report] section with exclude_lines for common non-testable patterns (if __name__, pragma: no cover)
Run `uv sync --dev` to install pytest-cov
Run `uv run pytest` and verify coverage report is displayed
Verify that the test run fails if coverage drops below 80%

description: Update AGENTS.md with release workflow and coverage documentation
steps: Add 'Release and Versioning' section to AGENTS.md documenting the release flow
Document `make release-rc` command and its effect (creates RC tag)
Document `make release` command and its effect (creates final version tag)
Document `make changelog` command
Document the `git push origin main --tags` step after release commands
Document that tags trigger CI/CD production deploy
Add 'Code Coverage' section documenting the 80% threshold and how to check coverage
Document that `make test` automatically includes coverage reporting

description: Verify release workflow and coverage enforcement work end-to-end
steps: Run `uv sync --dev` and verify commitizen and pytest-cov are installed
Run `uv run pytest` and verify coverage report is shown with percentage
Verify coverage threshold enforcement by checking that tests fail if coverage is below 80%
Run `uv run cz version` and verify it returns the current version from pyproject.toml
Verify `make help` includes release-rc, release, and changelog targets
Verify `make changelog` generates or updates CHANGELOG.md
